<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **5** documentable anchor(s).

**3** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx`  _(via PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES (symbol, a top-level const object))_
- `content/docs/permissions/record-view-auditing.mdx`  _(via view_all_audit_log (literal, a string literal in PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES))_
- `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`  _(via installAuditLogReadVisibility (symbol, a top-level function))_

⛔ **1** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via view_all_audit_log (literal, a string literal in PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **58** of **210** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **171** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2aefbcde88274fdb6de117cd9d2c7920b36d391e` — the merge of head `e94fcd240ecc95c3fecb352f7010958877dade4a` into base `847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2aefbcde88274fdb6de117cd9d2c7920b36d391e && git checkout 2aefbcde88274fdb6de117cd9d2c7920b36d391e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14 e94fcd240ecc95c3fecb352f7010958877dade4a && git checkout -B drift-repro 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14 && git merge --no-ff e94fcd240ecc95c3fecb352f7010958877dade4a

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 847e4248e9b7059e5b069056bf636c75c1f53b14` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `af925f22afb66fc213fe7f4654e3a331367a94b3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts, .changeset/26750-ledger-deployment-level-rows.md (narrowing face, no remainder); cited code read on the live tree: packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/auth-event-audit.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/read-audit.ts, packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts, packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts, packages/core/src/security/posture-ladder.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/meta-write-capability.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-rls-filter.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-session-audit.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts, packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, docs/adr/0095, docs/adr/0131.

Check-runs on the head at review time: every completed run is `success` or `skipped` (Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Spec property liveness, all Lint and Type Check source/consumer/debt gates, Dogfood Regression Gate, Build Docs, Build UI Deps, Test UI, Build & E2E UI). Still `in_progress`: Test Core (8 shards), Type Check · workspace, Type Check UI, Live E2E UI, Build Core. The verdict below is on the diff, the card and the completed runs; the in-progress runs are the queue's gate, not this record's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set, the ledger read.** Every non-system engine read of `sys_audit_log` (find, findOne, count, aggregate: `PARENT_GATE_READ_OPS`) by a context that does not carry the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung gets `tenant_id` not null and not empty ANDed into its `where`, after the parent-record gate, which plans its parents off the caller's own `where` (`andIntoWhere` wraps, never replaces). Right: this is ruling A (6457448424) as written, one rule in every posture, including the holder of `view_all_audit_log`, whom the gate exempts and this clause does not.
- **Under a wall, shipped sets: no change.** `sys_audit_log_org` (`tenant_id == current_user.organization_id`, default-permission-sets.ts:214) already excluded NULL-tenant rows for the shipped sets; the new clause is a subset of what that policy already removes. Right. Under a wall with a custom set that authors its own ledger row policy or the read bypass: the NULL-tenant half is now closed; the cross-organization half is declared out of this card and left on #26640 (withheld). Right, and correctly declared in the changeset.
- **Platform administrator: unchanged where the rung is carried.** `readsDeploymentLevelLedgerRows` reads `context.posture === PLATFORM_OPERATOR_POSTURE` ('PLATFORM_ADMIN', metadata-core). The rung is derived once, server-side, in `resolve-authz-context.ts` 6d (`derivePosture` from `anchorsPlatformStanding` grants or the config-derived admin; not wall-gated, so `single` derives it too) and carried by `assemble-execution-context.ts` (`posture: authz.posture`, authenticated principals only). No transport reads a posture off the request (grep of the HTTP, MCP and runtime doors). Not forgeable from the client. Right.
- **Fail closed on no rung.** A context with no `posture` is treated as not the platform administrator. Narrower than the RLS filter's precedent (`security-plugin-rls-filter.ts:194`, which falls back to a capability probe) and the same as `suggested-audience-bindings.ts:934`. Direction right (never widens). Consequence named in ④ as should-fix: a `runAs:'user'` automation context is seeded with positions and permissions but not the rung (`run-resume.ts:215`), so a flow running as the platform administrator is served organization rows only.
- **Writes, system reads, context-less reads: unchanged.** The middleware's existing early return covers them. Right.
- **Driver semantics of the clause.** `$ne: null` lowers to `IS NOT NULL` on driver-sql (sql-driver.ts:14716) and excludes null and missing on memory/mongo (memory-driver.ts:1577); `$ne: ''` is NULL-safe on SQL and is ANDed behind the null test, so a NULL never reaches it. Same pattern as `ledgerRowAboutNoRecordWhere` in the same file. Right.
- **Stamping, the rule's premise.** `audit-writers.ts:2096`: `tenantId = recordOrgId ?? sess.organizationId`; under `single` a `session.create.before` hook stamps `activeOrganizationId` (auth-manager.ts:835, ensure-default-organization.ts), so the CRUD mirror, record-view `read` rows and login/logout rows (`auth-session-audit.ts:171/195`, from `session.activeOrganizationId`) carry the Default Organization on the normal path. The residual NULL class (system writes about an object with no organization column, sudo paths with no session organization) was already hidden from organization readers under a wall and is now hidden under `single` too; the changeset's Before bullet names it. Right, and this is the ruling's own consequence, not a defect of the rule.
- **Public surface.** `audit-log-read-visibility.ts` is not re-exported from the package index (only `audit-plugin.ts` imports it), so the two new exports are internal. `packages/spec`: one description string in `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES`; no schema shape, no generated artifact carries the description (grep: only source and test files name `view_all_audit_log`); `check:generated` and Spec property liveness green. Right.
- **Dogfood pin flip** (`admin-ledger-decision-metadata.dogfood.test.ts`, outside `hits`, read for the claim): every row about the subject is written by the platform administrator's endpoints with no organization, so under ruling A no class reader is served one; the decisions-only guarantee moves to the rows at rest, and a control row carrying the readers' organization proves each reader's ledger read resolved. A faithful flip caused by the ruling, not a fix-to-green. Right.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the PR body and in the changeset; `Metadata-protocol: none` on both. Right: a read narrows for a custom grant, nothing a metadata author can write changes.
- Level: `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-audit` and `@objectstack/spec`. Right by AGENTS.md Post-Task #3: `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition; both present (`**BREAKING** read narrowing …`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)`), plus the upgrade note for `single` operators. `fix(plugin-audit)!:` title. `Check Changeset` green.
- The spec bump is description text on a published const: `patch` is the right level; no `skip-changeset`.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Cross-organization half under a wall (custom ledger policy or read bypass).** Flagged by the dev as outside this card; escalated to #26640, where the detail stays withheld. Accepted; nothing of it is reproduced here.
- **The card's first step (measure `group` / `isolated` with a custom set omitting `sys_audit_log_org`).** Reported done by the dev with no NULL-tenant leak found. Read-only here, so not re-measured; it does not bear on the rule's correctness, which applies in every posture independent of the row policy. Not pinned by a test in the tree (the new integration test boots without the security plugin, by design). Noted, not a finding.
- **Final-head dispatch-gates reconciliation.** The PR body says the 106 families on `af925f22` were re-running and the reconciliation goes in the card's report comment. At review time the card holds four comments and the last is the claim: the report is not there yet. Open until it lands (should-fix 3).
- No `open_questions` entries; no TODO/FIXME added by the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` (hits).** The one added sentence states, for `single`, exactly what ruling A ordered the description to gain, and it does not contradict the sentence before it (walled postures, platform administrator). It holds against its first consumer: the plugin-audit middleware serves exactly that set, pinned per posture in `audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts` (find, count, a `tenant_id: null` filter, findOne by id, grouped aggregate, for the holder, the organization admin and the platform administrator). Scope `'org'` unchanged. Tried to break it: the description still says the platform administrator reaches every row; that is true wherever the request path carries the rung, and the exception (contexts built outside the resolver) is a plugin-audit fact, so it belongs in the changeset, not in the capability text.
- *Should-fix 2.* The code comment directly above the row (lines 70-80, unchanged by the diff) still says the platform administrator reaches deployment-level rows "through its superuser read bypass, not through this capability". After this change the bypass is half the mechanism: under a wall the bypass skips the row policy, and in every posture the plugin-audit rule admits the carried `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung. One clause naming the rung keeps the comment and the new sentence telling the same story.

**`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts` (the read rule, in scope on the narrowing face).** Does the narrowing make the spec's own refusal real? Yes: the description on `main` already promised that deployment-level rows are the platform administrator's; the rule now enforces it where no row policy did. Tried to break it: the rung cannot be supplied by a client; the clause is ANDed after the gate so the gate's parent planning is unchanged; count and aggregate ride the same AST (`engine-count-aggregate.ts`); a mis-cased rung, a `platform_admin` position, an `admin_full_access` permission or capability all answer false (unit pins, and ablation 2 in the PR body shows the position pin is live); `findOne` by id of a withheld row answers null, as the gate does. The only behaviour I could reach that the declaration does not name is the fail-closed case below, which is narrower, never wider.
- *Should-fix 1.* A context assembled outside `resolveAuthzContext` carries no rung and is served organization rows only, the platform administrator included. The reachable instance in the tree is a `runAs:'user'` automation run (`service-automation/src/run-resume.ts` seeds positions, permissions, peers and email; not `posture`). Name it in the changeset's Unchanged bullet ("the platform administrator reads every row as before" holds only where the request path carries the rung) and either seed the rung in `seedRunGrants` on a follow-up card or state that a flow reading the ledger does so in system context. Fail-closed, so not a FAIL.

**`.changeset/26750-ledger-deployment-level-rows.md` (in scope on the narrowing face).** Declaration lines, BREAKING banner, ADR-0087 marker and upgrade note are present and match the diff. Before/Now/Unchanged bullets match the tree, with the one qualification in should-fix 1. The upgrade note's "The organization's own record history ... still served" is true for the normal stamped path; the residual NULL class is already listed in the Before bullet, so the note is complete enough.

Must-fix: none.
Should-fix: (1) changeset qualifies the platform administrator's "as before" with the carried rung and names the run-as case, with a follow-up to seed the rung or state the system-context read; (2) the capabilities.ts comment above the row names the rung beside the bypass; (3) the `af925f22` dispatch-gates reconciliation lands on the card before the queue.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-edzevh`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `3fa0b74303605db6aebb5b5c1e342e88b9babf53`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts + packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts, .changeset/26750-ledger-deployment-level-rows.md (narrowing face, no remainder); cited code read on the live tree: packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-writers.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/auth-event-audit.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/read-audit.ts, packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts, packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts, packages/core/src/security/posture-ladder.ts, packages/metadata-core/src/meta-write-capability.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/objects/default-permission-sets.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-rls-filter.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-session-audit.ts, packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts, packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts, packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, docs/adr/0095, docs/adr/0131.

This head follows `af925f22`, reviewed PASS by this seat. The delta `af925f22..3fa0b743` is one commit touching two files, prose only: the changeset's Unchanged bullet (one sentence qualified, one added) and the code comment above the `view_all_audit_log` row in capabilities.ts (one clause). No source, test, description string or generated artifact changes; the net diff against `origin/main` is the reviewed diff plus those two hunks (11 files, +565/-119). Every judgment below that the delta does not touch is re-stated from the reviewed record and still holds against the tree.

Check-runs on the head at review time: completed and `success`: Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check PR Size, Check Documentation Links; `skipped`: Schedule gate, Packed-tarball smoke, 18.x upgrade harness. Still `in_progress` or `queued`: Check Changeset, Spec property liveness, every Lint and Type Check gate, PR-body guards, Flag docs affected, Auto Label; the Build, Test Core, Test UI, Dogfood and E2E runs had not started. The delta cannot change any of their answers from `af925f22`, where every completed run was `success` or `skipped`, since it edits a changeset body and a comment, but their conclusions on this head are the queue's gate, not this record's.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set, the ledger read.** Unchanged by the delta. Every non-system engine read of `sys_audit_log` (find, findOne, count, aggregate) by a context not carrying the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung gets `tenant_id` not null and not empty ANDed into its `where` after the parent-record gate (`andIntoWhere` wraps, never replaces). Right: ruling A (6457448424) as written, one rule in every posture, the holder of `view_all_audit_log` included.
- **Under a wall, shipped sets: no change.** `sys_audit_log_org` already excluded NULL-tenant rows; the clause is a subset of what it removes. Right. The cross-organization half of a custom walled set stays on #26640 (withheld). Right, declared in the changeset.
- **Platform administrator.** The rung is derived once, server-side (`resolve-authz-context.ts` 6d, `derivePosture` from `anchorsPlatformStanding` grants or the config-derived admin, not wall-gated) and carried by `assemble-execution-context.ts`; no transport reads a posture off the request. Not client-forgeable. Right. The delta's changeset sentence now says exactly this: the administrator's read holds on a request carrying the rung. Right.
- **Fail closed on no rung.** A context built outside the resolver carries no rung and is served organization rows only; the reachable instance is a `runAs:'user'` automation run (`run-resume.ts` seeds positions, permissions, peers, email; not `posture`). The delta names it in the changeset and leaves `seedRunGrants` untouched (declared out of scope by the dev). Narrower, never wider: right, and now declared.
- **Writes, system reads, context-less reads: unchanged.** Right.
- **Driver semantics.** `$ne: null` is `IS NOT NULL` on driver-sql and excludes null and missing on memory/mongo; `$ne: ''` is ANDed behind it. Right.
- **Stamping premise.** Under `single` the `session.create.before` hook stamps `activeOrganizationId`, so CRUD, record-view and login/logout rows carry the Default Organization on the normal path; the residual NULL class is the ruling's own consequence and is named in the changeset's Before bullet. Right.
- **Public surface.** The read-visibility module is not re-exported; the spec change is one description string carried by no generated artifact. The delta adds a comment only. Right.
- **Dogfood pin flip.** Unchanged by the delta; a faithful consequence of the ruling, not a fix-to-green. Right.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body and in the changeset; unchanged by the delta. Right.
- `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-audit` and `@objectstack/spec`, `**BREAKING**` banner, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, upgrade note: all present; the delta edits the Unchanged bullet only and keeps every declaration line intact. Right by AGENTS.md Post-Task #3 (a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` with its banner and disposition). `Check Changeset` was green on `af925f22` and is in progress on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Should-fix 1 (reviewed record): resolved.** The changeset's Unchanged bullet now reads that the platform administrator reads every row "on a request that carries the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung, which the request's authorization context resolves for the administrator", and that a context built outside that resolution is served organization rows only, fail-closed, with the `runAs: 'user'` run named. Matches the tree (`run-resume.ts` seeds no posture). Seeding the rung in `seedRunGrants` is left out of this PR and declared out of scope; acceptable, since the behaviour is narrower and now documented. No follow-up card number is cited on the PR; a one-line pointer when one exists would close the loop.
- **Should-fix 2 (reviewed record): resolved.** The capabilities.ts comment above the row now says the deployment-level rows are served in every posture only to a request carrying the `PLATFORM_ADMIN` rung, naming #26750 and the plugin-audit module, beside the existing superuser-bypass sentence. The comment and the description now tell one story. Comment only; the description string is byte-identical to `af925f22`.
- **Should-fix 3 (reviewed record): pending.** The `af925f22` dispatch-gates reconciliation promised for the card's report comment has not landed: the card still holds four comments, the last being the claim (6519222523). The gate families are unaffected by this delta (prose), so the reconciliation from `af925f22` still describes this head's code; it belongs on the card before the queue.
- **PR body stale on the head.** The Verification section still reads "Final head `af925f22`". The body is prose and not reviewed under ④, but the queue guard and the next reader read the head off it; update the line to `3fa0b743` (should-fix 4, minor).
- Cross-organization half: escalated to #26640, withheld there. Accepted. The card's ordered measurement: reported by the dev, not re-measured here (read-only), not load-bearing for the rule. No `open_questions`; no TODO/FIXME in the diff.

### ④ Design judgment

**`packages/spec/src/security/capabilities.ts` (hits).** The published row is unchanged from the reviewed head: the one added sentence states for `single` exactly what ruling A ordered, consistent with the preceding sentence, and holds against its first consumer, the plugin-audit middleware, pinned per posture in `audit-log-deployment-level-rows.integration.test.ts`. The delta's comment clause is accurate against the tree: the rung is `PLATFORM_OPERATOR_POSTURE` read in `readsDeploymentLevelLedgerRows`, applied in every posture, and the superuser bypass remains the mechanism that skips the row policy under a wall. Nothing left to break here; scope `'org'` unchanged.

**`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/audit-log-read-visibility.ts` (the read rule, in scope on the narrowing face).** Byte-identical to the reviewed head. The narrowing makes the spec's own refusal real: the description on `main` already promised deployment-level rows to the platform administrator alone, and the rule enforces it where no row policy did. The rung cannot be supplied by a client; the clause is ANDed after the gate; count and aggregate ride the same AST; a mis-cased rung, a position, a permission or a capability all answer false (unit pins, ablation 2 live); `findOne` by id of a withheld row answers null as the gate does. The one behaviour outside the request path (no rung, fail-closed) is now declared in the changeset. No must-fix.

**`.changeset/26750-ledger-deployment-level-rows.md` (in scope on the narrowing face).** Declaration lines, banner, ADR-0087 marker and upgrade note intact. The Unchanged bullet now matches the tree in full, the qualification this seat asked for included. Before/Now bullets unchanged and still right. No angle-bracket fragments were introduced.

Must-fix: none.
Should-fix: (3, carried) the `af925f22` dispatch-gates reconciliation lands on the card before the queue; (4, new, minor) the PR body's "Final head" line names `3fa0b743`; (optional) cite the follow-up card for seeding the rung in `seedRunGrants` once one exists.

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-edzevh`
Reviewed-by: `session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
